deductible.definition: The amount you pay each year before the plan starts sharing the cost of basic and major work.

coinsurance.definition: The percentage of the allowed fee the plan pays after your deductible; you pay the rest.

annual maximum.definition: The most the plan will pay for your care in one plan year; after that you pay the full allowed fee.

waiting period.definition: How long you must be on the plan before certain services, such as crowns, are covered.

frequency limit.definition: How often the plan covers a service, such as two cleanings per calendar year.

alternate benefit.definition: When the plan pays as if you got a cheaper treatment (for example, a silver filling instead of a tooth-colored one) and you pay the difference.

balance billing.definition: When an out-of-network dentist bills you for the gap between their fee and what the plan allows.

usual and customary.definition: The fee the plan considers normal for a service in your area, used to set what it pays out of network.

eob.definition: Explanation of Benefits: the statement your insurer sends showing what was billed, allowed, paid and what you owe.

fsa.definition: A flexible spending account that lets you pay for dental care with pre-tax money, but unused money can expire.
